regime_context: The CSI 300 tape is a narrow, two-narrative rotation: Banks (rank 1, eligible, crowded) lead Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, eligible, crowded) by a 0.01 margin. Cross-sectional momentum here is an attention lens only (rank-IC ~0), and the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so even the one validated edge is absent — treat every lean as low-conviction and conditional. Track record shows 55.8% hit rate but only 37.7% directional accuracy on 77 calls, so default to humility.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, challenger) closes the 0.01 margin over Banks in momentum score — a confirmed handoff only exists if Pharma & CXO takes rank 1 AND holds eligible status for 10 trading days; until then Banks remain the incumbent leader and no next-narrative is being called.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the top eligible theme with the highest momentum score, a 0.73 durability bar (strongest in the set), and 0.889 breadth — the widest participation of any theme. The rotation leadership is narrow (18% eligible) and Banks sit at the head of it. This is a direction to be long the incumbent leader while trend persists, not a forecast of continued outperformance. Crowding_z 1.78 is a size-down caution, not a fade; I cap rather than chase.
theses.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that the absolute-trend gate did not hold on China A-shares history — this tape mean-reverts and whipsaws trend followers, so a crowded rank-1 theme is exactly the setup that has historically stalled. Momentum rank carries rank-IC ~0, meaning the top rank has no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: The challenger sits 0.01 behind Banks in score with a 0.6 durability bar and 0.643 breadth — a legitimate second leg of the narrow two-theme leadership. It is also crowded (z 1.59), so this is the same incumbent-long logic, not a rotation pick. If Banks stall, Pharma & CXO is the only confirmed alternative with eligible status and real momentum.
theses.dissent: Crowding is nearly as elevated as Banks and breadth is meaningfully narrower (0.643 vs 0.889). With gate_helps=false and rank-IC ~0, being long the #2 crowded theme on a mean-reverting tape has no validated edge — it may simply be the next drawdown candidate.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is rank 3 with a 'trend' Hurst tag but is NOT eligible (eligible=false) and has breadth of only 0.059 — leadership has not spread. The durability bar is 0.28, well below Banks and Pharma. This is not a fade or a short; it is an avoid until the absolute-trend gate confirms a durable trend, which it explicitly does not on this market's history.
theses.dissent: The Hurst tag says 'trend' and this could be an early-stage theme that the narrow-gate (only 18% eligible) is missing. Avoiding an incipient trend that later broadens would cost upside.
